affected_party: QIF authors, accountable adjudicators, evaluators, AI agents, and affected stakeholders
actual_problem: QIF preserves disagreement and adjudication, but repeated adjudication findings cannot yet become an explicit, reviewable rubric revision without manual interpretation or silent mutation.
why_it_matters: Without a governed feedback path, known ambiguity repeats, rejected alternatives disappear, evaluator behavior changes without trace, and rubric edits may gain false authority.
why_now: v0.6.37 records disagreement and v0.6.38 preserves policy drift; rubric feedback is the smallest missing learning link before counterfactual replay and empirical calibration.
